title: Agent check, a person moved the check to other law
about: The check names SYN-OLD-1 (store below 30 °C). A person moved it to SYN-NEW-1 (below 25 °C), with SYN-DEF-1 as a supporting source. The leaflet says below 30 °C. Attention. Law is cited only from SYN-NEW-1 and SYN-DEF-1, and the tools never get a call on the old source.

check.question: Does the leaflet storage statement follow the labelling rule?

pages:
Cover letter

Halden Biotech FZ-LLC submits an application to register Corvane 500 mg film-coated tablets, containing corvanidine hydrochloride. The enclosed files are the application form, the quality overall summary, the stability report and the leaflet. The product is a generic of a reference product registered in another country. Please contact the regulatory affairs office for any question.

Patient information leaflet

Corvane 500 mg film-coated tablets
Read all of this leaflet carefully before you start taking this medicine.

How to store Corvane

Keep out of the sight and reach of children. Store below 30 °C. Keep the tablets in the original package.

clauses.text: Storage statement. The leaflet shall tell the patient to store the medicine below 30 °C.
Storage statement. The leaflet shall tell the patient to store the medicine below 25 °C and to keep it in the original package.
Language. The storage statement shall be written in every language of the leaflet.
Definitions. In this glossary, a leaflet means the printed information for the patient that is packed with the medicine.
